title: Preparation of Nasopharyngeal Samples for Immunofluorescence Assay
author: Maria Lucia Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w8rfhv6

steps.title: Collect Sample
steps.instruction: Add the nasopharyngeal sample into a conical tube.

steps.title: Mucus Reduction
steps.instruction: For samples containing significant mucus, treat with N-L-Acetyl-Cysteine to reduce viscosity.

substeps.instruction: Add a maximum of 1ml of N-L-Acetyl-Cysteine into the tube

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 300 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Homogenize Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Homogenize the resulting pellet of cells using 1x phosphate-buffered saline solution (PBS 1x).

steps.title: Prepare Glass Slide
steps.instruction: Apply the cell suspension to a glass slide and dry.

substeps.instruction: Drop 5ul of the diluted cell suspension onto a glass slide
Allow the sample to dry inside the hood or in front of a hair dryer

steps.title: Fix Sample
steps.instruction: Fix the cells using cold acetone.

substeps.instruction: Immerge the glass slide into pure and cold acetone

steps.title: Wash and Store
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed slide and store at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Wash the slide once in PBS 1x
